claims.quote: The hummingbird tetra, Trochilocharax ornatus, is a tiny characid from Amazonian Peru, reaching only 17 mm SL.

regions.name: Ampiyacu
regions.quote: In the description Zarske (2010) states that there is conflicting information to the origin of the fish in the trade, with some stating it to be collected from a blackwater tributary of the río Ampiyacu near Pebas while others claim that it's native to the rio Nanay near Iquitos.
